worldcombat.skill.screech.summary: Scream an earsplitting shriek straight down a narrow corridor. Sound ignores cover, so everyone lined up loses Defence; a sharper shriek cuts deeper while a drawn-out one reaches further and rings longer.
worldcombat.skill.screech.use.0: Strip the Defence of enemies charging at you in a line
worldcombat.skill.screech.use.1: Press physical threats through a low wall
worldcombat.skill.screech.use.2: Soften a whole rank coming through a doorway
worldcombat.skill.screech.description.0: Every enemy in the corridor loses %1$s stages of Defence and hears the ringing for about %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.screech.description.1: The wave reaches %1$s blocks ahead and %2$s blocks to each side; anyone standing in it is pierced.
worldcombat.skill.screech.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.screech.preference.shr: Off (drawn cry): a wider, longer corridor that rings longer at the base drop. On (piercing shriek): the corridor narrows to about 60% and the wave shortens by 20%, but Defence drops one stage further and the cooldown is slightly shorter. Depth against duration.
Only consider the shriek when a threat is within this distance; larger commits earlier and risks hitting nothing.
Only prefer the shriek when at least this many enemies stand in the corridor; set 1 to shriek on sight.
On: skip when the enemies in the corridor already have ringing ears, saving the shriek. Off: keep shrieking.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to deliver the shriek.
